name: heading
label: Heading
default:
Referrals got you here.
They won't get you the next stage.

name: stat_body
label: Stat Body
default: Of B2B buyers used AI during a recent purchase, and Gartner's broader research puts B2B buyers spending only about 17% of their total buying time meeting directly with potential suppliers. The rest happens independently, increasingly with AI in the room.

name: stat_source
label: Stat Source
default: Source: Gartner Sales Practice, "Gartner Survey Finds 69% of B2B Buyers Turn to Sales Reps to Validate AI-Generated Insights," May 2026; Gartner B2B Buying Journey research.

children.name: title
children.label: Title
children.default: Vendor research starts before the referral conversation

children.name: description
children.label: Body
children.default: IT buyers increasingly research candidates in AI chat tools before they ever ask a peer for a recommendation.

default.title: Vendor research starts before the referral conversation
default.description: IT buyers increasingly research candidates in AI chat tools before they ever ask a peer for a recommendation. If you're not structured to be cited there, you're off the shortlist before anyone picks up the phone.

default.title: Referral-heavy growth doesn't scale predictably
default.description: Word-of-mouth built the business, but it's founder-dependent and hard to forecast. Found First builds a second, owned channel that compounds independently of any one relationship.

default.title: PE-backed growth plans need repeatable pipeline
default.description: Investors want a pipeline model that isn't tied to a single rainmaker. Organic AI + search visibility is the kind of asset that shows up in a diligence deck: durable, measurable, and transferable.

default.title: Competitors are already claiming the AI-cited spots
default.description: Answer engines tend to cite a small set of sources per query. Every month you wait is a month a competitor's content becomes the default answer instead of yours.

name: icp_note
label: ICP Note
default: Long, relationship-driven sales cycles and referral-heavy growth make these buyers especially exposed when discovery moves to AI, and especially well-positioned to win once they're built for it.
